confidence_notes: Food anchors rest on aggregated 2026 sources (Numbeo-based restaurant figures, a cappuccino average, and bar pricing benchmarks), though sources conflict on dinner-for-two and some pages are dated. Beer and cocktail are partly inferred. Wine uses a beer-relative basis because direct standard-menu data was weak. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not from inspected listings, and are less certain. The FX observation was taken from a search summary of the RBA page, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was needed. Anchors are based on San Antonio, Texas, a mid-sized US metro where restaurant and bar prices are near or somewhat below national averages. Accommodation reflects typical budget and midscale US city rates.
